LanguageData.RHAH_RefugeeMassacre.questDescriptionRul: questDescription->[sponsorName] says a temporary Ratkin camp nearby may threaten their settlement. Kill every resident within 15 days of accepting for 12 goodwill. There are 2 to 4 adults and 8 to 16 Ratkin young under 8, living in wooden huts with no turrets or power. Downing or capturing them does not finish it.
